notes.title: Scope reduction Under a Desert Sun
notes.notes:
Dear everyone,

Since 2017 I've been working on this project with the hope of building a cool VR game with cool mechanics, a horde mode, flightmode and including a singleplayer experience.

It's been a long journey and one where I've learned a lot! As most of you have noticed I've had a hard time polishing and finishing the first singleplayer chapter. This is due to the fact that making VR game is quite complex. 

With the limiting time I have working on this and the encreasing complexity coming with every bit of the singleplayer I've decided to scrap the singleplayer. 

In coming updates I will most likely remove the singleplayer maps and will remove any promises of this coming from the steampage.

This also means that once that update is done I will tone down development of Under a Desert Sun VR. For everyone allong for the ride thank you! All the feedback has been greatly appreciated!

I'd like the next project to be something lighter and more likely to finish without reducing scope.

Lastly a small poll/question. Do you want me to remove or leave the existing sp levels?

Kind regards everyone,
Raymond

[u]Spring clips[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27812936/6f4dd0e8314b73feddf75b196bb1d6b705d6313a.gif[/img]

[b]New blood impacts[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27812936/3838c9ccb987a23947374bdf7bd41c9a7a225252.gif[/img]
Living Nazi's and undead Nazi's have new more realistic blood impacts. Before I was using some standard assets in unity to just have the idea of blood impacts. They never looked very nice and were not very visible. I've updated this to more realistic an cool looking blood splashes. They have the added benefit of being more random, so each hit should look sort-of unique. Let me know in the comments if you like these better then the old ones!

[b]Improved holster mechanics[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27812936/85d7e9da71374d360fe5f226f4a0ccb6102228ac.gif[/img]
The holsters used to have these misfires where the gun would drop. This was just very anoying so I rewrote all the code for holsters. Using Toggle as well as Grab mode (See the menu) you now will be able to always perfectly holster your weapon.

[b]Bolting issue resolved[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27812936/136f6cbe4ee5a1cef535be7ca2bf8f54c61c5df9.gif[/img]
It came to my attention that a nasty bug sometimes made bolting weapons annoying. If you'd pull a bolt really quickly it would sometimes stop just shy before actually bolting the bullet. You'd have to let go and try again..This is..cumbersome..to say the least when there are 20 mummies waiting in line to eat you..I fixed this problem. You should now always be able to bolt succesfully.

[b]Camera effects[/b]
I've added saturation and colour adjustment effects to the camera in specific maps. You can see it well in this example picture below. It allows me to make a scene look more "hot" for example when in the desert. This effect is a major addition also to single player maps as they will be much larger and can have open spaces as well as small rooms with massively different lighting and colour variations.

[u]Not saturated lighting[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27812936/17957029a7824e3e37b17fcd4db2016ce8dd12ec.png[/img]

[u]Saturated lighting (Feels hotter)[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27812936/2121b364470a604e15f08a18c7e4eb65d63be968.png[/img]

[b]Loading screen[/b]
Lastly a small thing, I noticed that if you are looking in the wrong direction of the loading screen you might not know what is going on. So I added a small message telling you to turn around ;)

[b]Arthur time![/b]
Super lastly, Arthur is doing great. He's groing super fast and is 7 months already. Look at the happy little dude!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27812936/404e78a87250c569669c295e46f4fa8e5712225b.jpg[/img]


Let me know what you think in the comments and if you run into anything tell me on discord:https://discord.gg/g5fK7Df

notes.title: Under a Desert Sun B0.60
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Here again an update with small content improvements that actually come from my work on the SP. Once again there are several performance improvements which I hope you notice. Furthermore the following additions have been made:

[b]Chambered bullets[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27812936/adc56e388e2eed4c8c33f79d4ccdd15d8e6f239e.gif[/img]
Guns now have a properly chambered bullet. I know it would be even more realistic if a bullet flies out if there already is a bullet chambered. However I've chosen to not do this for now for comfort reasons. I might change this in the final run as I have the code ready to also discard full bullets if users find that cool. Let me know on discord or the comments what your opinion is on this!

[b]Living enemies update[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27812936/396d1ba4f5cf6812c1b514d5aa2514a5826d0cb5.gif[/img]
I've updated behaviour and animations on the living enemies (The bad dudes with guns ;)). Before they would angle in weird angles when you'd get to close. Now they have a more natural aiming angle in all cases. They also try to get distance between you and themselves by punching or kicking you and walking backwards. Lastly you can now shove them just like the undead enemies when they are close as you can see in the gif.

[b]Blood cam update[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27812936/1c8209092ff4464d6e8b0511f73f9e9b84ac93bd.gif[/img]
The blood on your face/camera effect I had before had a big hit on performance even on high end machines (About 10 fps). I found this unacceptable and changed to a more performance friendly option. These little decals have far less impact on the performance. Added bonus is that they give a more accurate feel on when you get hit as you really only see them if a hit or bullet damages you.

[b]Dust death[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27812936/ec2c34169d1d8300c7026e841f9f264a1d55535c.gif[/img]
I noticed that undead enemies would not fade into dust when dead. I fixed this bug so all undead should become sand once again! 

[b]Starting lobby change[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27812936/a6827c19dc72f053adcc1ace2b3316f6fca081ca.gif[/img]
I changed the starting lobby a bit. Main reason is performance but it also gives a more logical set if rooms to look around in.

[b]Loading screen[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27812936/9b1cead22103c8d0964624a70350d9f10620af95.gif[/img]
I've added a loading screen method. This way it's clearer that you are waiting for a map to load. Before the screen would just go dark. The loading screen now, shows temporary images that I plan to change with more relevant info. The technology is now there so this is mainly a tech update.

This update will be live in the next few hours, let me know what you think in the comments or on discord!

Kind regards,
Raymond

notes.title: Under a Desert Sun - Weapon improvements and further development SP!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

In this bigger update several items come together. As usual they are mostly results from the development on the single-player that I release early as they can be used in the wave-maps and test-maps of the current state of the game as well. 

[b]Controller update[/b]
With help from a tester, thanks Greg, and some advice from a fellow dev, thx thomas!, I've been able to set a new profile specifically for knuckle controllers. As some of you know the knuckles would work less well with my game compared to other controllers. The new profile fixes this by setting some default settings to work better with knuckles. From now on the following should work better on Index/knuckles:

[list]
[*] You squeeze less hard to grab things (I still recommend setting the grabbing options to "grab" instead of toggle in the menu for knuckle controllers) before you'd really have to hold on tight to keep things in your hand. Less handcramp yaay! 
[*] The "A" button releases the weapon magazine (This also works for Oculus and Microsoft headsets)
[*] Less drift and accidental movement
[/list]

notes.title: Final Alpha update
notes.notes:
Hi there,

I am very happy to announce that this is the last alpha post. This means that after this update Under a Desert Sun will enter beta phase. Just to recap:

[b]For Under a Desert Sun I try and work in 3 main phases:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Alpha phase, in this I create functionality and test it by implementing it in wavemaps or test maps. The wave maps will stay as a separate mode when the game is finished next to the singleplayer
[*] Beta phase, will focus on creating the singleplayer and narrative
[*] Pollish phase, an extensive bug fix and pollish period where we make sure everything works optimally and performance is improved as much as possible.
[/olist]

[b]In this post I want to do two things, [/b]
[olist]
[*] Mention the changes in this particular patch
[*] Recap all the things that are now available in beta
[/olist]

[b]Changes and additions In this last alpha update[/b]
[u]Updated weapon behaviour[/u]
[list]
[*] Colt1911 is now manual reload
[*] Improved manual reload on most weapons
[*] Fixed Colt, Luger and Bar ammo clip drop bug. They would pop trough gun geometry sometimes.
[*] Fixed bolting bug where you can pull bolt further then it should go. 
[/list]
[u]Updated the tutorial level[/u]

The alpha phase is there so I can make and test many mechanics that I will use in the singleplayer. You, the player, have helped me enormously by testing these mechanics in the wave maps and test maps available in the current early access.

I would appreciate it if any comments, ideas and bugs would be mentioned to me on my discord channel for the game instead. Trust me, I am listening and always answer any questions and reports. see the link below in this update text.


[b]Realistic hand behaviour[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27812936/d95280f118bc882c3a3e2dde53e6bf098aec303e.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27812936/3b6bf267f84430c012c78d771a69949265925d2d.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27812936/6b85f4c7b64d3630e9b78dbf01d9673a28ffe19b.gif[/img]
I wanted the hands to not move through objects anymore. As most big VR games have this feature and it’s really becoming the norm I wanted to make sure Under a Desert Sun does not lag behind on this aspect. I’ve implemented an early version of hand collision that in my opinion works quite nicely. It does the following:
[list]
[*] Hands do not move through objects anymore
[*] If you push your hands through a wall or an object the hand stays somewhere close to the entry point of the wall
[*] You can still move your hand along the wall
[*] Your fingers move in accordance to the wall, this is quite neat, the vingers bend a bit with your hand, just like in real life! It doesn’t work perfectly because that would cost too much performance but the illusion works well enough. I Think it adds to the immersion.
[*] When holding a weapon your hands still can’t go through the wall and when a weapon sticks out too far into an object it will turn and make sure it does not go through the wall, this last bit is not perfect yet, weapons can still stick slightly in a wall. 
[/list]
As a lone developer this is some pretty intense/math stuff so I will keep working on this to perfect it. However, I think for a first attempt in the alpha this works quite well already.

[b]Flying[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27812936/8176ac07e37717647f5c1a138a12303aa72b7136.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27812936/84446a4bc365c2803f8554b1f529dee43dddba88.gif[/img]

[*] Added airplane targeter, it points towards a target, handy!
[*] Added more enemies with more complex follow behavior(The enemies no longer crash into you and try to shoot you while getting behind you)
[/list]
Please keep in mind that I am still working on bullets and shooting, even though the enemies try to shoot you and you can shoot, you won’t be able to hit anything yet ;) As I said, very alpha and only released so people can test things as early as possible.

[b]Small stuff[/b]
[list]
[*] I added a fade to black before a level is loaded. This is much easier on the eyes as the normal level loading behaviour was a bit jittery.
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] The mummy-like enemies no longer faded away after death, This is now fixed, dust everywhere!

notes.title: Under a Desert Sun update - alpha 0.501
notes.notes:
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=943033181
I've just released an update on the new alpha 0.5. This update contains a new module for touchpad movement. As previously mentioned this module is build up from the ground by myself, giving me more control, and less bugs because of external libraries and such. Bleh tech talk! :P

Thing's you might notice:
- The movement is no longer connected to your look direction. I found this anoying and counter intiuitive when strafing. You now simply move towards the direction you are pointing at on the touchpad.

- You can walk really slow, fast or anything in between, the new module made it easier to make sure you can move slowly. Also i've upped the walking speed slightly.

- The collisions are a bit jittery, this is the one big downside of my own model, which I am sure i'll fix in the future. 

In addition to the new touchpad movement i've fixed:
- zombie helmets floating in the air when shot (As you can see in the gif above),
- stg44 ammo was backwards when you grab it,
- small code stuff you probably didn't notice ;)

in the next update i will continue with ironing out some bugs among which:
- the bow arrows work badly on living enemies,
- sometimes grabbing a new weapon from the table glitches and suddenly you're holding two weapons in the same hand,
- when holding a weapon in both hands the controllers re-apear.
- the new airfield level is not pointermovement-proof, if you do your best you can get into places you aren't supposed to be.

Don't hesitate to post more bugs, it's one of the main reasons we're in early access after all!

Kind regards,
Ray

notes.title: Update alpha 0.5 - New enemies, a new map and a new gun!
notes.notes:
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=938047662

As you might have noticed the speed with which I bring new updates hase been slightly lower than usual. The main reason is that i've been working on some pretty big things for this release. 

With this update some of the larger elements will be introduced. Namely:
- Living nazi enemies! This update introduced the first version of living enemies. There's allot to still work on but these enemies are capable of shooting back and making things though for you in all sorts of new ways.They form the basis of all living enemies in the future technologywise.

- A new map, with the new enemies I wanted to make an environment that suits the enemies. Also, the singleplayer game will have a part of the story happen on an enemy desert airbase. 

- Lastly a new weapon. This update introduces the STG44 to the game. Go try it  out it's on the table!

Improvements and fixes
- The night and day map of the village have better textures
- Tweaks on several weapons
- Toned down the ragdolling effect so enemies fly around less
- Made sure that enemy helmets can be shot of the head with a satisfying PINGGGGGG :D

Promised but not yet implemented (Pushed to alpha 0.501)
I've also pushed some features from this release. The main reason was that I wanted to focus on getting the features in this release as stable as possible. This took more time then expected. These features are:
- Voice acting test technology, triggers and such that start voice acting
- Puzzle test technology, a map and technology for physics puzzles and such

As always try the tutorial if you are new! And don't forget that you can take any weapon you want with you into a portal as long as you hold it in your hand!

notes.title: Update alpha 0.403 - Tweaks and a new inventory slot!
notes.notes:
This is the second update with tweaks on alpha 0.4. In this update i've mainly focused on the inventory system. The most important addition is a new third inventory that allows you to hold two guns. In the challange maps you now always have a handgun and any additional gun you brought from the main loby. In other words you can now bring a shotgun and grab your handgun if you run empty!

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=914641567

Other tweaks and improvements:
- More code simplification and cleanup. 
- Inventory weapons can now swap. In other words if you hold a gun and want to grab another, the held gun is swapped with the one in the inventory slot.
- Ammo Immediatly changes when grabbing a gun. This was needed because you can now swap guns on the fly having two inventory slots
- Picking up the bow from the table and taking it into the portal works, before  this was the only weapon that you could not take with you.
- All interactions are now left/right independend, in other both controllers work in every situation. Only difference between left and right are the movement button layout.

Bugfixes:
- Fixed a small bug where multiple weapons would be spawned on the table
- Fixed the shotgun shells being placed in your hand backwards
Upcoming:
For alpha 0.5 i'm looking into the following:
- New enemies
- New maps
- Puzzle behaviour
- Triggered voiceacting events

Singleplayer:
Just to remind everyone, every bit of functionality that's made right now is in service of the single player that I will start building once the technical building blocks are there. The functionality made so far and that will be made for alpha 0.5 will all be seen again in the singleplayer campain.

As always check the tutorial on the right if this is your first time!

notes.title: Update alpha 0.401 - Tweaks and burning arrows!!
notes.notes:
As I mentioned in the dev diary on the UDS youtube channel I wanted to do some small tweaks before I start on the true 0.5 work. It turns out this was really needed because i've been able to make a slew of small improvements. 

As I also mention in the dev diary I tried to listen to your remarks and desires concerning the game. In a small twitter questionere I asked if there are any types of weapons people would still like to have. Most people wanted burning arrows, something that was also mentioned on reddit allot. Well..this patch contains just that!

[URL=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=910265356] Burning arrows![/URL]

For now you can still find the bow on the well in both challange maps. Pretty soon i'll make sure that you can simply grab it from the table and take it with you!

Tweaks and improvements:
- Overal code simplification. 

- You now only feel the upper inventories buzz when you hold the bow. Otherwise these inventory slots are not used, so there was no need for buzzing. 

- Both controllers work in any of the inventories. Before there was a mandatory left or right controller for the inventory. This was anoying because you could, for example, not grab ammo with your right controller. I've made the inventories "controller side independent". So now you can grab your gun using either controler and grab ammo using either controller. This allows me to soon add a new inventory slot for handguns at the chest area!

- Improved the grip sound of the shotgun

- Fixed a small bug where sometimes the shells of the shotgun would not eject properly

Upcoming:
Keep an eye out on the forums and this board to get an idea of alpha 0.5 soon!!

As always please try the tutorial on the right to get an idea of the current controls. Also use the portals to start a map!

notes.title: Here we go!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

With this very first announcement I’d like to focus on the soon to be release Early Acces of Under a Desert Sun. A game that, once finished, will be a story driven VR shooter with full motion control and a fun adventure to be had in a Mummy and Nazi invested desert.
We’re not there yet of course and this is early access after all. 

During development we’ll go through 3 main phases:
-Building game mechanics
-Story writing
-Building the story game with the game mechanics

So if you decide to buy this game now, what you’ll get is a small Proof of concept setup which I am using to verify game mechanics. The proof of concept basically is a wave based shooter. I intend to add new things to this setup over time. These things can vary from, new movement options or new sounds to new sets of weapons.
For those who are along for the ride, feel free to post on the forums what you think, find and would think is cool to add!

Lastly a shoutout to some people who've been a great help during the preparation phase:
- Thomas (Containment initiative, awesome game you guys should play it), had so much help and support awesome!
- Darrel, super tester!
- Vasanth Mohan(Fusemen), awesome tutorials and help on VR+Unity development, check them out on: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCLO98KHpNx6JwsdnH04l9yQ

Thanks so much for the support and help so far!
